title: Erdős #1065 OQ-06: Cunningham Chains and Safe Primes (Long Chain Existence)
description: Formalizes Cunningham chains of the first kind and their connection to Erdős #1065 (safe primes). Proves: concrete chain examples [2,5], [3,7], [2,5,11,23], structural properties (valid chains, Sophie Germain condition), prime congruence constraints, and the open conjecture that chains of every length exist. 1 axiom for the long chain existence conjecture. 24 theorems.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: long chain existence conjecture (open problem).

overview.historicalContext: Cunningham chains: sequences p₁, 2p₁+1, 2(2p₁+1)+1, ... where all terms are prime. Infinitely many safe primes would follow from chains of all lengths.
overview.problemStatement: Prove structural properties of Cunningham chains and formalize the open length conjecture.
overview.proofStrategy: Define IsCunninghamChain inductively; verify concrete examples; prove constraints; axiomatize long chain existence.
keyInsights: **cunningham_chain_length_n**: For every n, there exists a Cunningham chain of the first kind of length n (open conjecture)
